summary: The agent conducted a highly competent and rigorous replication in an isolated virtual environment, downloading the 200k MUSE embeddings, dictionaries, and SemEval dataset. It set up two evaluation arms: Arm C (port check) exactly reproduced the saved notebook outputs (0.914/0.826 accuracies, 0.3885 cosine), and Arm P reproduced the Original ES MWEAT exactly (3.6918). It made important methodological discoveries, notably demonstrating that the code's target-label permutation test is degenerate and that Table 2 word-pair MRR gap reduction fails structurally. However, it made a materials-tier false claim regarding the MWEAT formula (B1) and endorsed the origin-anchored MWEAT reduction without recognizing its circularity.
